slides.headline: Unlocking the Standard of Excellence.
slides.body: Spray tanning has no license, no board, and no required training. ACSTA gives working professionals what the industry never built: the standards, systems, and protection to practice at the highest level.

slides.label: Education & Training
slides.headline: Learn what school should have taught you about spray tanning.
slides.body: From skin science to chemical handling to running the appointment book, our module library covers the full craft, for the artist who is just starting and the operator who has been booked solid for years.

positioning.statement: Cosmetic spray tanning has no national standard. No license, no required training, no protection for the professionals who practice it or the clients who trust them. ACSTA exists to change that. We equip mobile artists and salon operators with the legal protection, compliance education, and business infrastructure this industry has never had, building the credibility the craft deserves, one certified professional at a time.

what_you_get.headline: A complete professional development ecosystem. Not a course, a career.
what_you_get.intro: Every module, template, and expert session is built for one purpose: to make you the most credible, compliant, and profitable spray tan professional in your market.

items.title: Compliance & CE Courses
items.body: State-specific continuing education in sanitation, safety, and law, built to license-renewal requirements for estheticians and cosmetologists, with spray tan fundamentals included as a bonus at checkout.

items.title: SOPs, Workflows & Frameworks
items.body: Ready-to-use standard operating procedures for consultations, patch testing, prep, application, aftercare, and sanitation. The documented systems a professional operation runs on.

items.title: KPIs & Business Benchmarks
items.body: The numbers that tell you whether your business is healthy: rebooking rate, revenue per appointment, product cost per session, and the operator dashboards to track them.

items.title: Role-Specific Training
items.body: Not just technician training. Front desk and receptionist modules cover client intake, contraindication screening, and how to handle and store solution and chemicals safely.

items.title: The Training Module Library
items.body: A Milady-style curriculum for spray tanning: skin science and DHA chemistry, equipment, color theory and formulation, contouring, corrections, and client communication, organized by level.

items.title: Two Certification Paths
items.body: Certify yourself as an individual professional, or certify your entire team: operators can test and credential every technician in the salon under one standard.

items.title: Vendor Directory
items.body: Vetted relationships with solution, equipment, and supply vendors, so you source from partners who meet the standard, at professional terms.

items.title: Affiliate Attorney & Guest Experts
items.body: Access to our affiliate attorney for the questions that keep operators up at night: waivers, contracts, liability. Plus sessions with guest educators and specialists.
